event_chain.summary: Communications to water towers/lift stations disrupted

summary: Overnight on Sunday July 26, 2026, the City of Plymouth, Minnesota lost communications to cellular-connected equipment at two water towers and several wastewater lift stations in a cyberattack that was part of a coordinated campaign against more than 30 Minnesota municipal water utilities (and systems in other states) targeting internet-facing PLCs. Crews ran the system manually and restored communications by Tuesday afternoon; water levels and quality were unaffected. A leaked WaterISAC memo tied the campaign to Iranian state-sponsored hackers; US agencies have not formally attributed it.
